name: voice

dataset.speech: offline operating-system voices, English only, optionally degraded

notes: Synthetic speech from offline OS voices: not real patients, accents, Hindi or Hinglish.
Languages without an installed voice are reported as untested, never as passing.
No claim of reliable Hindi or Hinglish is made anywhere in this system: speech recognition for them was not tested, and the fixed Hindi/Hinglish explanation templates are unreviewed.

text_to_speech.hindi: no Hindi voice is installed: Hindi text is shown, never read with an English voice
text_to_speech.hinglish: Hinglish is read with the English voice and may be mispronounced; not evaluated

en.speech_recognition: checked on synthetic English speech only (docs/eval/voice.json); not on real patients' voices or accents
en.explanations: fixed English templates, written by the project's author
en.voice: an installed offline English voice, when present

hi.explanations: fixed Hindi templates, written without review by a Hindi-speaking clinician: UNREVIEWED
hi.voice: only if a Hindi voice is installed; never substituted by another language's voice
hi.claim: no claim of reliability is made for Hindi or Hinglish

hinglish.explanations: fixed Hinglish templates, written without review: UNREVIEWED
hinglish.voice: read with an English voice, which may pronounce Hindi words poorly
hinglish.claim: no claim of reliability is made for Hindi or Hinglish
